# `merge-assist` command

Propose resolutions for the conflicts of a merge, rebase or cherry-pick, checked by the compiler. The git state is
never changed.

```bash
fobis merge-assist [PATHS...] [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [AI assistance](/cookbook/ai).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

Arguments: `PATHS...`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Specify a "fobos" file named differently from "fobos" |
| `--fci` |  |  | Assume fobos inputs as case insensitive |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | Select a mode defined into a fobos file |
| `--apply` |  |  | Ask hunk by hunk (accept/ours/theirs/both/edit/skip) and write the accepted resolutions to the working tree. Nothing is ever staged. |
| `--yes` |  |  | With --apply, no questions: accept the high-confidence deterministic resolutions and the model proposals that compile; leave the others in conflict. |
| `--no-model` |  |  | Deterministic resolutions only; no model. |
| `--context` |  |  | Print what the model would receive for each hunk, run no model. |
| `--format` | TEXT | `text` | Output format: text, or json (the report on stdout; asks nothing). |

<!-- cli:end -->
